ko: 이 세상 가장 아름다운 순종의 눈물
온 세상 다시 빛나게 한 생명의 눈물
en: The most beautiful tears of obedience in this worldTears of life that made the whole world shine again

ko: 그가 이 땅에 오신 이유 죽어야 살게 되고
en: The reason He came to this earth by dying we come to live, by losing we gain the victory a wondrous and eternal mystery.
Restoring us just as He created us,Christ, our Creator
fulfilled the Father’s willthrough the way of the cross

ko: 그 소망 그 사랑 그 생명
en: Now entrusted to usare that hope, that love, that life
The beautiful and radiant way of the cross—the reason we live on this earth
